description: Pillar overrides for the Agriculture vertical. Replaces the generic Carbon Offsetting area with Water Stewardship, which is the primary sustainability lever for agricultural operations.

offsetting.label: Water Stewardship
offsetting.description_override: Manage water resources sustainably across your agricultural operations.

drip_irrigation.title: Precision Drip Irrigation
drip_irrigation.description: Install precision drip irrigation across all farm zones, reducing water consumption by up to 50%.

rainwater_harvesting.title: Rainwater Harvesting Infrastructure
rainwater_harvesting.description: Build rainwater collection and storage systems across operational zones.

no_water_action.title: No Water Investment
no_water_action.description: Defer all water management investments. Risk of regulatory action in water-stressed regions.
